title: Find the bug in a double_all function

metadata.notes: Bug: reassigning the loop variable n does not mutate the list. Fix should build a new list (e.g. `[n * 2 for n in nums]`) or index-assign `nums[i] = n * 2`. Revised (2026-09-23, V2.6 Phase 1) to request a fenced code block for the sandboxed grader; bug/difficulty unchanged.
